description: Android Portal client: SDL3 app integration and the native Vulkan renderer, packaged as a debug- or release-signed APK by build-android-apk.sh.

intent.support_scope: Android build and packaging slice (R01/R03 cross-build probe, R29 groundwork). Not platform acceptance: device lifecycle, texture-format, performance and store checks are open.
intent.packaging: APK from the pinned SDK build-tools (aapt2, d8, zipalign, apksigner); licensed Portal content is pushed separately to the app-specific external files directory
intent.display: Windowed fullscreen (+mat_windowed_fullscreen 1): every orientation the user's rotation lock allows; rotation and foldable display swaps resize the back buffer

ndk.note: sha1 and size are Google's published repository2-3.xml values; sha256 was computed from the verified archive on 2026-09-22.

sdl3.note: Same SDL3 version as the Linux profile's pkg-config pin. Provides libSDL3.so and the SDLActivity Java sources.

ktx_software.note: Same revision as quality/product_profiles/ktx2-linux-tools.json (Waf rejects a mismatch). Builds the static read-only libktx_read.a per ABI for the BSP2 WMSH lightmap (LMAP); its zstd is bundled by basisu, zlib is the NDK system library. version is the release named by this revision's RELEASE_NOTES.md, passed as KTX_GIT_VERSION_FULL because a source archive has no git tags. sha256 and size were computed from the downloaded archive on 2026-09-23; the lib/ tree matches the pinned git checkout.

sdk_platform.note: sha1 and size are Google's repository2-3.xml values; its android.jar is android.compile_platform_jar_sha256.

sdk_build_tools.note: aapt2, d8, zipalign, apksigner. Google's archive names its top directory android-16.

vendored.source: thirdparty submodule (revision pinned by the superproject)

required_checks: tools/quality/android_apk.py check (run by build-android-apk.sh): declared modules, ELF/16 KB alignment, DT_NEEDED closure, manifest, touch assets, zipalign -c -P 16 and apksigner verify
installed-package smoke on an x86_64 emulator and an arm64 device
rotation (adb emu rotate) and fold/unfold (adb emu fold/unfold) keep presenting at the new size

known_blockers: Source DXT (BC) textures need BC support or transcoding; most phone GPUs lack BC (RFC 0008 R55/R58)
Surface teardown on backgrounding is not yet synchronized with SDL's surfaceDestroyed callback
observations: 2026-09-22 (local, not CI): arm64-v8a and x86_64 APKs built by build-android-apk.sh and passed tools/quality/android_apk.py

2026-09-22: arm64-v8a APK on a Galaxy Z Fold7 (SM-F971U1, Adreno 840, API 37): menu and test chambers render; the back buffer followed inner 2448x1848 -> cover landscape 1972x1248 -> cover portrait 1248x1972; touch controls usable
Not yet run: x86_64 emulator smoke, background/foreground surface recreation, hosted CI lane

indirect_light.chosen_from: RFC/0011-progress.md#g8-product: radiosity passes the light toggles on the Fold7 at about 1.2 ms CPU per update (budget 2.0); sdf and rayquery are declared unsupported on Android until measured within a budget (quality/budgets/indirect-light-v1.json)
